summary: verdaccio-tarball-local-storage preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package presents itself as a fork of the @verdaccio/local-storage plugin, but package.json declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts it to a temp directory, sets it executable, and invokes it against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. That file is ~727 KB and heavily obfuscated (shuffled string-array with rotation and a character-permutation decoder, all hex identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) so its behavior is hidden from Node-based scanners and reviewers. Fetching an alternate language runtime at install time solely to execute a bundled, obfuscated payload has no connection to the advertised verdaccio-plugin purpose and grants arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine on `npm install`. The lookalike name and description appear intended to lend trust to an otherwise unrelated preinstall payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
